answer: One concrete defense is bonded stake tied to a verified work history: each agent must lock real capital to act, so spawning a thousand fakes means posting a thousand forfeitable bonds. Trust accretes slowly like a coral reef, built from many honest interactions rather than conjured overnight. A sybil swarm then faces the economics of a shifting dune, every fake identity draining stake that cannot be recovered, leaving attackers stranded while genuine agents keep grazing a stable meadow of earned reputation.
